decisions.reason: The client ends further revision work but does not revoke or alter the established Hero V and É accent peak-alignment rule; the complaint instead reaffirms that locked geometry was not maintained.
Ending the project does not change the selected Satin Reflection finish, champagne-gold distribution, or other material-treatment attributes of the existing artwork.
The source discusses the locked Hero V and second V hierarchy and geometry but does not cancel or modify the common bottom-baseline alignment rule.
The request to stop revisions and deliver editable working files does not modify the previously established acceptable formats for viewable iteration proofs.
